title: MainHeader and PluginEditor assembly — tabs, resizing, header, CMakeLists
description:
Fan-in GUI assembly: MainHeader + PluginEditor tabbed shell, resizing, wiring, and CMakeLists GUI sources (spec §21.1, §21.3).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §21.1 Window (default ~1280×760, min ~920×580, resizable, high-DPI)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §21.3 Main Layout (header strip, timeline, controls, expert/page area)
- Existing Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp skeleton from a.3 (ChugGateAudioProcessorEditor)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h for analysis getters / APVTS / sidechain / latency / CPU hooks if present
- All Source/GUI/* components from i.1–i.5
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources patterns from prior phases

Implement MainHeader.h/.cpp:
- Header Component: preset selector, profile selector, A/B controls, key source status, sidechain present/active indicator, Align/Learn shortcuts if not solely on Perform, Bypass, latency readout, CPU readout.
- Wired via APVTS + callbacks into StateManager/processor methods without implementing preset DSP here.

Upgrade Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp:
- Own ChugLookAndFeel (setDefaultLookAndFeel / setLookAndFeel) for the editor lifetime.
- Host MainHeader, PerformanceTimeline, StateIndicator, and a tabbed container for Perform / Shape / Detect / Align / Diagnose pages.
- Default size 1280×760; setResizeLimits(920, 580, …); setResizable(true, …) appropriate for plugin+standalone.
- resized() layout matching §21.3: header top, timeline (+ state indicator), active page body.
- Wire analysis objects from processor into timeline/align/diagnose when accessors exist; timer to pump AnalysisFifo→PerformanceHistory if that pumping is owned by the editor (only if processor does not already do it — prefer non-duplicating wiring).
- Keyboard focus traversal enabled; no controls clipped at minimum size.

CMakeLists.txt:
- Sole owner this phase: add all new Source/GUI/*.cpp and ensure PluginEditor.cpp remains listed on plugin targets. Do not restructure unrelated targets beyond necessary source lines.

Do NOT modify DSP modules or ParameterIDs.h except reader use.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp host MainHeader, PerformanceTimeline, StateIndicator, and tabbed Perform/Shape/Detect/Align/Diagnose pages
ChugGateAudioProcessorEditor default size is 1280x760 with minimum resize limit 920x580
Editor installs ChugLookAndFeel for its component hierarchy

CMakeLists.txt lists ChugLookAndFeel.cpp, PerformanceTimeline.cpp, StateIndicator.cpp, PerformPage.cpp, ShapePage.cpp, DetectPage.cpp, AlignPage.cpp, DiagnosePage.cpp, MainHeader.cpp, and PluginEditor.cpp for the plugin target
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: restructure CMake beyond adding GUI/PluginEditor sources to existing targets
change plugin bus layout or parameter tree definitions

allowed: TabbedComponent or custom text buttons switching owned page unique_ptrs
minimal processor accessor usage to inject analysis pointers into child components
append GUI .cpp paths to existing target_sources in CMakeLists.txt
forbidden: reimplement page control grids inside PluginEditor instead of hosting page components
delete or redesign APVTS parameter layout
broad CMake cleanups unrelated to GUI sources
